name: Tessellate Labs
description: Maker of design collaboration software in the fictional city of Corrie Haven.

items.title: Product roadmap highlights
items.content: The public roadmap promises offline mode in Q1 2027 and real-time comments for up to 64 editors. Page TSL-RM-27.

items.title: Education discount
items.content: Schools and universities get 72.5% off with a verified domain; renewals are yearly. Policy TSL-EDU-4.

items.title: Code review rules
items.content: Pull requests need 2 approvals and must keep coverage above 81.3%; design review is led by Ottilie Grange. Guide TSL-CR-813.

items.title: Office desk booking
items.content: Desks on floor 5 are booked through the app by 17:20 the day before; standing desks are D41 to D48. Rules TSL-DSK-5.

items.title: Office coffee machine lease
items.content: The office coffee machines are leased from Beanstead Vending at $274 a month, serviced every 6 weeks, until 2027-09-30. Lease TSL-COF-0930.

items.title: Planned price increase
items.content: Team plan prices rise from $12 to $15.50 per seat on 2027-02-01; enterprise customers keep current prices until renewal. Memo TSL-PRC-0201-T.
